summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of duplicate locations in the .pot file, but it lacks comprehensive testing and may need to be applied to additional related functions.

issues.description: The patch does not include tests to verify that the issue is fully resolved and that no new duplicates are introduced.

The patch only addresses one part of the issue and may need to be applied to other related functions such as `babel.messages.pofile.PoFileParser._process_comment()` and `babel.messages.catalog.Message.__init__()`.
